name: Disgraces
description: Black Crusade, Table 2-2 (p. 71). A Disgrace may be chosen or rolled. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.name: Betrayal
results.text: Starting Corruption +5. Untrustworthy: -10 situational modifier to all Charm attempts.

results.name: Greed
results.text: Starting Corruption +4. Overwhelming Need: -10 situational modifier to all Commerce attempts.

results.name: Regret
results.text: Starting Corruption +5. Haunted: opponents receive a +10 situational modifier when using Intimidation against the character.
